cases.observed_message: Thin gate delegated apply does not extend PR create beyond front-half preflight; use dry-run planning only for pr-create-preflight
notes: The rejection is intentional and contract-owned: the thin gate must not flatten branch materialization, remote publish, or live PR publish into delegated apply.
